text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — elevated 5xx rate observed for service inference-proxy across eu-west-1. Threshold crossed (5m) — auto-escalating to oncall. Paging @raj (oncall).

raj (oncall): On it. Pulling traces now. Any deploys in the last 10m?

miguel: Yes, tiny rollout (minideploy) of middleware header parsing change just finished canary -> 30% about 8m ago.

sara: saw a few reports from smoke tests but they were intermittent, didn't block rollout. checking error logs.

raj (oncall): If it's that change, we should either disable the feature flag or revert the single commit. Which is faster?

dominik: Revert is fastest since flag is baked into a lib path. I can yank the commit and push a hotfix. Anyone else prefer flag kill?

miguel: Revert is fine. commit is 9a7f3b2 (small parser tweak). I can produce the revert PR right away.

raj (oncall): Miguel, please do PR for revert and tag me. Sara, prepare monitoring and smoke test. Dominik, be ready to trigger rollout. Support, hold off on customer comms until we know impact.

miguel: PR created: revert/9a7f3b2 -> main, CI passed. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4821

sara: running quick smoke suite against the canary group. copying the failing stack traces: ``Error: invalid header token at parser.js:142`` repeated in 238 requests last 5m.

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: hotfix/revert/4821 -> service=inference-proxy, env=eu-west-1, strategy=immediate 5 instances. CI: green.

dominik: kicking off the hotfix deploy now. Command I used:
```
redwoodctl deploy --service inference-proxy --image hotfix/revert-4821 --region eu-west-1 --strategy immediate
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started. 0/5 pods updated.

raj (oncall): Notify if any customer-facing latency spikes during rollout. Tracking logs, updating PagerDuty status.

deploy-bot: 3/5 pods updated. Health checks passing on updated pods.

support-sam: Support queue — saw ~6 customer error tickets tied to inference timeouts in EU. Marking high-priority until we confirm fix.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. 5/5 pods updated. Post-deploy health: OK.

sara: Post-rollback telemetry: 5xx rate dropped back to baseline within 45s of first replaced pod. Error traces for invalid header token disappeared from sample.

emily (product): Any user-visible impact? If it's the header parser, some API clients with malformed headers might have failed. Support: please prepare brief note.

support-sam: Will draft a KB: "Small regression in header parsing after recent change, fixed by revert. If you saw 5xx, retry requests now. No data loss." Will send to ops for review in 10m.

raj (oncall): Great work. Assigning postmortem owner — miguel, can you write a short blameless postmortem and include rollback decision rationale and why smoke tests missed it?

miguel: Yep, will submit a short postmortem and include repro steps + recommended additional smoke test for malformed headers.

raj (oncall): I'll close the page in 30m if metrics stay stable. Also let's add a temporary canary gate for header-related changes.

incident-bot: Incident closed by raj (oncall) at ts=1738123840. Duration ~6m. Severity: S2.

raj (oncall): Closing thread — thanks everyone. Follow-up: miguel to post postmortem, eng-runtime to add a canary check for header parsing, support to send customer note if any active tickets remain. :white_check_mark:
